evidence.note: MCP accepted and completed the terminal start_process near the request tail; no timeout completion marker was serialized.

historical_calibration.earlier_phenotype: assistant claimed execution window ended while an owned healthy validation process remained active and requested work was incomplete
historical_calibration.interpretation: 18:19 is the first independently confirmed recurrence after the known-good Aug 25/Aug 26 checkpoint, not the first-ever occurrence of premature process finalization.

proven: MCP server accepted and completed the final process before the assistant final.
The assistant final was an ordinary successful stop, not a serialized timeout/cutoff completion.
The ChatGPT-side tool-result node is ordered 2 ms after the assistant final in the raw export.
A universal 24m45 turn/tool ceiling is falsified by longer healthy controls, including the same GPT-5.6 Thinking/extended mode.
open: Whether the 2 ms result-after-final ordering reflects a product/tool-result delivery race, timestamp jitter, or another orchestration mechanism.
Whether control-layer composition increased the probability of this pre-existing execution-binding failure family after the 17:10 good checkpoint.
do_not_infer: Do not label MCP server outage as the cause.
Do not label a hard 24m45 platform cutoff as the cause.
Do not attribute the recurrence to one policy clause without a same-mode intervention/replay.

comparison_required: For healthy long-turn raw controls, compare final required tool-result node timestamp against assistant final timestamp. The race hypothesis is not promoted until that control comparison is available.
